ns2:course.label: Principles and Practices of Cannabis Flower Production
ns2:course.description: Explores indoor and outdoor cannabis flower production management practices. Topics covered include botany, growth and development, cultivar selection, planting and harvesting, growing systems and media, nutrient and water management, pest management, environmental controls such as lighting, media, ventilation. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
